dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent elliptical 'O' shaped structures on the posterior-lateral flank characterized by high-intensity light perimeters and low-intensity centers, exhibiting a sharp gradient from the dark exterior coat to the bright perimeter boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of high-intensity pixels occur at the intersections of the annuli network, forming a dense grid-like pattern in the mid-flank region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the five primary annuli form a non-equilateral pentagon on the mid-posterior lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct reticulated honeycomb pattern is localized to the posterior torso, transitioning into a uniform low-intensity texture toward the anterior region.
